[[File:Repulsorjammer_foc.jpg|right|thumb|An active repulsorlift jammer in use by the Zann Consortium]]
A '''repulsorlift jammer''' was a device that was capable of negating the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] fields of surface [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|vehicles]]. When active, the jammer would essentially cause enemy repulsorcraft to be stuck to the ground, unable to move. The [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] was known to make use of these types of devices as defensive emplacements during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was unable to afford repulsorlift jammers unlike the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] later expressing surprise that the Empire hadn't deployed them regularly against them in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''{{'s}} entry on the [[Imperial-class 1-H repulsortank|''Imperial''-class 1-H repulsortank]].
